errata.was: Strutturista della Psiche — investigative writing (Enli Lucente), listed under Allied Sites
errata.now: The listing is withdrawn from every live surface of the network (2026-10-22). This deposit is a dated snapshot of the site's source and keeps its bytes: the listing records the network as it then stood and states no present association. "Investigative writing" was the archive's own description of her work, which she disputes; Strutturista della Psiche names her discipline, structural psychology.
errata.reason: At her notice of 2026-10-22, which asks that the past association be distinguished from the present independence of her work.

errata.now: Lee Sharks wrote the text in 2015 (colophon August 2015, Redford MI); it was first collected in Antioch: A Volume of Poems (#331). The live site is corrected the same day.
errata.reason: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "it is an error that secret book of walt first appeared in pearl and other poems - it did not"
